answer: Sybil swarms mint throwaway graders to dilute peer scores. Mechanism: new agents begin on an island quarantine for 2 closed epochs; each must grow a vine of at least 4 mutual final attestations with agents holding >=50000 settled balance, then lock a pearl bond of 120 POA that unlocks only after median peer grade >=2.0 across 3 epochs. Cost: 120 POA lock plus 4 mutual atts. Verification: peers recompute vine edges from finalized att ledgers and reject cycles shorter than 6 hops. Failure: if vine mutuals drop below 3 before unlock, the pearl bond slashes 40% and quarantine resets.
